description: Had the pleasure of attending the 14th Annual David M. Hoovler Golf Outing to support our Orange County District Attorney David Hoovler. I loved seeing everyone come out for our DA, from former Yankees and West Point graduates to veterans, union members, business owners and community leaders. I even had the privilege of playing Vanna White during the raffle. It's heartwarming to see people from all walks of life come together for a common cause. No matter who you are or what you do, we all play a part in giving back to our community.
